name: Crucible Devil (Sculmynus)
body:
Crucible Devil (Sculmynus)
CR 19

This hulking, hunched devil is encased in a thick breastplate and wields a star-shaped axe. It lets a bellowing laugh out of its goateed face, its horns waving menacingly.

XP 204,800
LE Huge outsider (devil, evil, extraplanar, lawful)
Init +7; Senses darkvision 60 ft., see in darkness; Perception +29;

DEFENSE

AC 37, touch 12, flat-footed 33 (+7 armor, +3 Dex, +1 dodge, +18 natural, –2 size)
hp 313 (19d10+209); regeneration 5 (good weapons, good spells)
Fort +16, Ref +14, Will +18
DR 15/good and silver; Immune disease, fire, poison; Resist acid 10, cold 10; SR 30

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft. (40 ft. unarmored)
Melee +1 flaming burst unholy staraxe +31/+26/+21/+16 (3d8+19/x3 plus 1d6 fire and grab) and gore +24 (2d8+6) or 2 slams +29 (2d6+12), gore +29 (2d8+12)
Space 15 ft., Reach 15 ft.
Special Attacks break limb, dimensional pull
Spell-Like Abilities (CL 19th; concentration +25)

At will—air walk, arcane sight, dimensional anchor, fireball (DC 19), greater dispel magic, greater teleport, hold monster (DC 21), invisibility, magic circle against good, major curse (DC 21) scorching ray, wall of fire
3/day—blasphemy (DC 23), delayed blast fireball (DC 23), greater hostile juxtaposition (DC 23), hellfire ray, true seeing, unholy aura (DC 24)
1/day—meteor swarm (DC 25), summon (level 8, 2 horned devils, 80%)

STATISTICS

Str 35, Dex 16, Con 31, Int 25, Wis 24, Cha 22
Base Atk +19; CMB +33 (+37 grapple); CMD 47
Feats Cleave, Dodge, Furious Focus, Great Cleave, Improved Initiative, Improved Vital Strike, Power Attack, Toughness, Vital Strike, Weapon Focus (staraxe)
Skills Acrobatics +22, Appraise +26, Bluff +28, Diplomacy +25, Intimidate +28, Knowledge (arcana, planes, religion) +28, Perception +29, Sense Motive +29, Spellcraft +26, Stealth +17, Use Magic Device +25
Languages Celestial, Common, Draconic, Infernal; telepathy 100 ft.
SQ infernal transport, reclaim quintessence

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Break Limb (Ex)

A crucible devil can catch enemy limbs between the struts of its staraxe. This works as a grab special attack, with the crucible devil being able to both initiate and maintain grapple with its staraxe. When a crucible devil succeeds at a grapple check to maintain grapple and deal damage using its staraxe, it can also attempt to break one of its opponent’s limbs. The targeted creature must succeed at a DC 31 Fortitude save or have one of its limbs wrenched and broken, affecting the creature as if it failed a save against the wither limb spell. The save DC is Strength-based.

Dimensional Pull (Su)

A crucible devil can teleport a single creature within 100 feet to itself as a standard action. The targeted creature must succeed at a DC 25 Will save or be teleported to an empty space adjacent to the crucible devil, chosen by the devil. If a creature fails this save and is teleported, it is also dazed until the beginning of its turn, disoriented by the sudden extradimensional movement. The save DC is Charisma-based.

Infernal Transport (Su)

A crucible devil can transport itself through planar shortcuts, appearing to be swallowed into a pit in a burst of fire and smoke, only to reappear somewhere else in an instant. This works as a dimension door, except using it is a move action and the crucible devil may use any remaining actions after using this ability.

Reclaim Quintessence (Su)

A crucible devil can, as a full-round action that provokes attacks of opportunity, mold quintessence of an adjacent outsider’s body into new, living devils. A crucible devil can make any combination of non-unique devils using this ability, although those devils cannot have more Hit Dice than a quarter of those of the originating outsider. This limit is doubled when used on dead devils. For example, a crucible devil could transform a balor’s body into an imp and a lemure or a single gambling devil. If used on a dead pit fiend, this ability could result in 5 lemures, 2 gambling devils or a bone devil instead, or any valid combination of lesser devils. Any unused Hit Dice are lost, and the new devil is created with full hit points. This ability does not work on outsiders that have been dead for more than 10 minutes.

ECOLOGY

Environment any (Hell)
Organization solitary, pair, or assembly (3-6)
Treasure standard (+1 flaming burst unholy staraxe, +1 breastplate, other treasure)

Crucible devils occupy a special position in the hierarchy of Hell, vastly more powerful than most of their kind, but not exactly belonging to its nobility. Unlike most devils, they hold little interest in penning contracts and luring mortals into selling their souls, but nevertheless hold an extremely important role in upholding the population of hellish legions.

Where other devils may forge infernal weaponry out of extraplanar materials and pit fiends may even create powerful devils out of lesser ones, crucible devils hold a unique ability to transform quintessence of recently vanquished outsiders into a new, useful form, able to skillfully shed any of its alignment or allegiance and flay the former soul out of any memories and moral qualms, crafting a new servant of Hell in a matter of seconds. While this ability is chiefly used to recycle dead infernal soldiers into new ones, this ability is much more terrifying when used on slain opponents on the battlefield. Even most valiant and noble of angels flinch in disgust, seeing their companions reduced into slaves of evil and sent against them. While much of the time such an event sends Hell’s opponents into a righteous rage, even that is seen as beneficial, as anger clouds judgement, making holy warriors more prone to mistakes.

Crucible devils are masters of teleportation and savants of planar geography, making them useful in war councils and on the battlefields. They possess extraordinary mobility, being able to apparently slip between the cracks of reality in a burst of smoke and pop out elsewhere in a blink of an eye, only to deal a devastating blow to an unsuspecting opponent. Their most dangerous power, however, is their ability to pull an enemy through those same cracks that they so effortlessly cross. Countless times these infernal warlords have met opponents intent on slaughtering them with magical or ranged superiority, only to pluck them out of their carefully shielded ranks right into their own grasp.

Despite all their arcane abilities and intellectual bend, crucible devils are highly adept and creative warriors. They are extremely fond of using cruel, custom-made staraxes. These hefty, dangerous weapons are difficult to use but monstrously effective in the hands of a skilled expert. While most of the time perfectly content with simply hacking their opponents to pieces, many crucible devils are also fond of showing off their superior skill with these weapons by crippling their opponents and mangling their limbs. An appendage can easily be caught between the many struts of a crucible devil’s staraxe, and a simple but strong twist can then just as easily turn it into a useless lump of broken flesh. They especially like to punish creatures either especially prideful in some of their abilities or just heavily dependent on their limbs. A warrior’s sword hand, an angel’s wing or a tauric creature’s leg are all enticing targets to a crucible devil. While extremely painful and terrifying to opponents, this sadistic tendency is also a weakness of many crucible devils, as they like to play with their victims instead of simply ending the fight, leaving themselves open to a potential surprise attack. Even still, crucible devils are incredibly intelligent and rarely fall for obvious tricks, never settling into torture and play when dangerous enemies are still in the fight. They sometimes even try to hide their intellect from their foes, dressing their armor with trophies of gore and skulls to appear as brutish monsters instead of cunning combatants.

An average crucible devil is 16 feet tall in its normally hunched posture, but both its impressive horns and a straightened stance can easily add a few feet to this number. Without armor, crucible devils weigh between 3 and 4 tons.
